{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && PYTHONPATH=src:. python -c '
from cachetools.tagged import TaggedCache

# Overwriting replaces expiry - fixed test
now3 = [0]
c15 = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: now3[0])
c15.put("a", 1, ttl=10)  # expiry at t=10
c15.put("a", 2, ttl=1)   # expiry at t=1 (replaces old expiry)
now3[0] = 1
try:
    c15.get("a")  # t=1 >= t=1, should be expired
    print("FAIL: replaced entry not expired")
except KeyError:
    print("PASS: overwrite replaces expiry")

# Verify that with a longer TTL it would survive
now3[0] = 0
c16 = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: now3[0])
c16.put("a", 1, ttl=10)
c16.put("a", 2, ttl=10)  # expiry at t=10
now3[0] = 5
assert c16.get("a") == 2
print("PASS: replaced entry with longer TTL survives")
'
"}
